entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: A demented Izzet magelord from Ravnica who schemed for world domination; killed in a midair fight.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster whose omniscience Hauc was linked to and sought to overthrow.

entities.name: Crix
entities.description: Izzet League courier who concluded Hauc suffered from firemadness.

entities.name: Utvara Reclamation Zone
entities.description: Plague-ridden area above which Hauc exploded a bomb.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: A fold in space created by Hauc's failed bomb that sucks up ghosts of those who died in Utvara.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Local clan killed by the bomb's implosion.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Owners of the zone who wished to redevelop it.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Orzhov Pivlic who helped stop Hauc and was killed in the process.

entities.name: Vor Golozar
entities.description: Gruul chieftain who helped stop Hauc.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Baroness who claimed her inheritance in Utvara, gained control of an albino dragon hatchling and rode it against Hauc.

events.summary: Hauc explodes a bomb above the Utvara Reclamation Zone, which kills the local Gruul by implosion but creates the Schism instead of exploding.
events.quote: The machine killed all the local Gruul with an implosion but didn't explode.

events.summary: Hauc secretly heats three dragon eggs for years, planning to take over the hatchlings' minds and raze the city.
events.quote: Hauc heated the eggs for years, hoping to hatch them and then take over their minds

events.summary: Teysa Karlov's move to Utvara spurs Hauc to hatch and enslave a blue dragon hatchling; Teysa replicates his spell for an albino hatchling.
events.quote: Teysa replicated Zomaj's spell and gained control over an albino hatchling

events.summary: In a midair fight Hauc is flung into a cliff and dies; both dragons die against a mizzium outcrop, and Kos is killed.
events.quote: Hauc was flung into the side of a cliff and died as the albino dragon mortally wounded the blue one

relations.note: Izzet magelord under guildmaster, who secretly plotted against him
relations.quote: Hauc's brilliance and obsession with himself were rivaled perhaps only by his guildmaster, Niv-Mizzet .

relations.note: planned to smite him and raze the city
relations.quote: enabling him to smite the Firemind and raze the City
Were it not for Agrus Kos , his Orzhov Pivlic , Izzet League courier Crix and Gruul chieftain Vor Golozar
